err_cannot_cancel: This update cannot be cancelled now.
err_cancel_history: Update cancelled. Its history could not be saved.
err_development_detail: The update stopped at “{step}”. {reason} See update/development/{phase}.log for details.
backup_reason_busy: Another backup operation is running. Try again when it finishes.
backup_reason_coordination: Check that writers have resumed before clearing the recovery marker.
backup_reason_private_directory: Only the owner may access the backup folder (0700).
backup_reason_directory: Choose a valid private backup folder.
backup_reason_retention: Choose between 1 and 50 snapshots to keep.
backup_reason_missing: A required file, folder or backup tool is missing.
backup_reason_permission: The hub lacks permission to access a required file or folder.
backup_reason_storage: The hub could not read or write backup data.
backup_reason_command: A backup command exited with code {code}.
backup_reason_validation: The backup data or settings failed validation.
backup_reason_archive_link: A history link could not be safely included in the backup.
err_development_step: The development update stopped at the “{step}” step. Check update/development/{phase}.log on the hub machine.
development_step_web_build: Build Web app and public sharing
err_beta_channel: Beta updates need the official GitHub release source and a valid beta manifest; the current source stays unchanged
err_busy: The assistant and agents stayed busy, so it didn’t update. Try again later
reason_went_back: Went back to the old version
reason_no_start_one: The new version failed to start {count} time
reason_no_start_other: The new version failed to start {count} times
reason_marker_unsaved: Couldn’t save the update’s start count, so a crash loop couldn’t be caught
rolled_back: Updating to {to} didn’t work, so the hub went back to {from}: {reason}
push_failed_body: {why}. This version won’t be installed automatically again.
reason_machines_missing: These machines didn’t reconnect within 2 minutes: {machines}
push_updated_body: Installed automatically while the assistant and agents were idle. personad on your computers will switch to this version too.
not_release_docker: This hub can’t update itself: a hub in Docker updates with a new image (docker compose pull && docker compose up -d)
not_release_no_source: This hub can’t update itself. No release update source is configured. Set update.url in hub.json and restart the hub.
not_release_private_no_source: This hub can’t update itself. Private network mode is on. Set update.url in hub.json to an internal release URL and restart the hub.
not_release_bad_source: This hub can’t update itself: hub.json’s update.url can’t be used ({error})
not_release_dev: This hub can’t update itself: development build ({version})
why_docker: A hub in Docker updates with a new image (docker compose pull && docker compose up -d)
why_no_source: No release update source is configured. Set update.url in hub.json and restart the hub.
why_private_no_source: Private network mode is on. Set update.url in hub.json to an internal release URL and restart the hub.
err_no_binary: This version has no binary for {platform}
err_release_moved: A newer release, {newer}, was published while {version} was downloading. Update again to install it
err_no_image: Don’t know which image this hub is: compose didn’t pass PERSONA_IMAGE into the container
image_private: Couldn’t check for a new image: {error}. Set PERSONA_REGISTRY_TOKEN in .env (a token that can read this image), or make the image public
image_failed: Couldn’t check for a new image: {error}
err_no_start: The new version did not start; the old one keeps running: {error}
reason_no_takeover: The new version could not take over: {error}
reason_not_confirmed: The new version was not confirmed within 3 minutes
err_program_unreplaced: Version {version} has no {program} for {platform}, and {service} runs it: installing it would leave {program} on the old version. Wait for a release that includes it
err_development_config: The backup writer quiesce and resume commands in hub.json must be configured as a pair, or both left empty to use the hub's built-in pause.
err_development_external_quiesce: This hub snapshots extra databases, extra roots, or another local manager that the built-in pause cannot stop. Configure both backup quiesce and resume commands in hub.json.
err_development_topology: Development updates require the Hub to start its built-in assistant.
err_development_platform: Development updates need a hub on Linux or macOS.
err_development_quiesce: The hub could not pause its writers for the backup: {error}
err_computer_packages: The hub updated, but computer packages could not be prepared. Their staged files are retained on the hub machine; inspect the update logs before redeploying computers.
err_development_recovery: An interrupted development update needs recovery. Inspect update/development/adopting.json and the retained snapshot on the hub machine before updating or changing sources.
err_resolve_latest: Could not check the latest commit. Try again.
err_development_phase: Could not prepare the development update. Inspect update/development/{phase}.log on the hub machine. The previous build and verified snapshots are retained.
err_development_backup: This program backup is no longer available. Refresh the backup versions.
err_development_backup_path: That backup folder can't be used: {error}
err_development_backup_recovery: The current snapshot folder needs recovery before it can be changed: {error}
err_quiesced: The hub is pausing its writers for a backup. Try again in a moment.
err_quiesce_timeout: The built-in manager did not stop in time for the backup.
err_development_docker: Web development updates aren't available for a Docker hub; update it with a new image.
